tax_year.rationale: CalendarYr maps directly to the calendar year printed on the form.

payer_name.rationale: Blueprint bundles payer name into one string but canonical schema splits into BusinessNameLine1Txt and BusinessNameLine2Txt under PayerName; mapping to line 1 as primary, but blueprint should split into two fields for full alignment.

payer_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles street/city/state/zip into one string; canonical schema uses PayerUSAddress or PayerForeignAddress group elements with sub-fields — blueprint should split into AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd fields.

payer_tin.rationale: PayerEIN matches the payer's taxpayer identification number field.

recipient_tin.rationale: RecipientSSN is the canonical element for the recipient's TIN (SSN/EIN/ITIN) on 1099-MISC; RecipientEIN at idx 29 is also a candidate but RecipientSSN is the primary match for individuals.

recipient_name.rationale: RecipientNm directly maps to the recipient's name field.

recipient_address.rationale: Blueprint bundles recipient address into one string; canonical schema splits into RecipientUSAddress or RecipientForeignAddress group elements with sub-fields — blueprint should split into AddressLine1Txt, CityNm, StateAbbreviationCd, ZIPCd.

account_number.rationale: RecipientAccountNum directly corresponds to the account number field on the form.

second_tin_notice.rationale: No candidate element for the '2nd TIN not.' checkbox exists in the supplied canonical list.

fatca_filing_requirement.rationale: FATCAFilingRequirementInd directly maps to the FATCA filing requirement checkbox.

void.rationale: No VOID checkbox element exists in the supplied canonical candidate list.

corrected.rationale: CorrectedInd directly maps to the CORRECTED checkbox on the form.

box_1_rents.rationale: RentAmt maps directly to Box 1 — Rents.

box_2_royalties.rationale: RoyaltyAmt maps directly to Box 2 — Royalties.

box_3_other_income.rationale: OtherIncomeAmt maps directly to Box 3 — Other income.

box_4_federal_income_tax_withheld.rationale: FederalIncomeTaxWithheldAmt maps directly to Box 4 — Federal income tax withheld.

box_5_fishing_boat_proceeds.rationale: FishingBoatProceedsAmt maps directly to Box 5 — Fishing boat proceeds.

box_6_medical_health_care_payments.rationale: MedicalHealthCarePaymentsAmt maps directly to Box 6 — Medical and health care payments.

box_7_payer_direct_sales_indicator.rationale: DirectSaleAboveThresholdInd maps directly to Box 7 direct sales checkbox for 2020+ forms.

box_7_nonemployee_compensation.rationale: No NonemployeeCompensationAmt element exists in the canonical list; this pre-2020 Box 7 value is not represented in the 1099-MISC MeF schema (moved to 1099-NEC).

box_8_substitute_payments.rationale: SubstitutePaymentsAmt maps directly to Box 8 — Substitute payments.

box_9_crop_insurance_proceeds.rationale: CropInsuranceProceedsAmt maps directly to Box 9 — Crop insurance proceeds.

box_10_gross_proceeds_to_attorney.rationale: AttorneyGrossProceedsPaidAmt maps directly to Box 10 — Gross proceeds paid to an attorney.

box_11_fish_purchased.rationale: FishPurchasedForResaleAmt maps directly to Box 11 — Fish purchased for resale.

box_12_section_409a_deferrals.rationale: Section409ADeferralsAmt maps directly to Box 12 — Section 409A deferrals.

box_13_excess_golden_parachute.rationale: No ExcessGoldenParachuteAmt or equivalent element exists in the supplied canonical candidate list.

box_14_nonqualified_deferred_compensatio.rationale: NonqlfyDeferredCompensationAmt maps directly to Box 14 — Nonqualified deferred compensation income.

box_16_state_tax_withheld.rationale: StateTaxWithheldAmt under Form1099MISCStateLocalTaxGrp maps to Box 16 — State tax withheld.

box_17_state_payer_state_number.rationale: Blueprint bundles state abbreviation and state ID number into one string; canonical schema splits into StateAbbreviationCd (idx 14) and StateIdNum (idx 15) — blueprint should split into two separate fields.

box_18_state_income.rationale: StateIncomeAmt under Form1099MISCStateLocalTaxGrp maps to Box 18 — State income.
